## Fleet

- [Access & oversight](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/access-and-oversight.md): Fleet gives you the control layer for scaling agents across your organization: tiered permissions, credential management, human-in-the-loop oversight, and an audit trail for agent…
- [Agent identity](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/agent-identity.md): Agent identity controls whose [credentials](/langsmith/fleet/workspace-admin) the agent uses when it interacts with apps and services.
- [Arcade integration](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/arcade.md): [Arcade](https://arcade.dev) provides managed MCP gateways that give your agents access to thousands of third-party tools behind a single integration.
- [Auth-aware tool responses](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/auth-format.md): Some [tools](/langsmith/fleet/tools) require user authorization (for example, Google, Slack, GitHub).
- [Channels](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/channels.md): Channels define when your agent starts running. Connect your agent to external events so it responds automatically to messages, emails, or other events.
- [Use Fleet agents in code](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/code.md): There are two main ways to use Fleet agents programmatically:
- [Agent platform comparison](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/comparison.md): [**LangSmith Fleet**](/langsmith/fleet/index) is an enterprise agent platform for building, sharing, and governing agents across your organization.
- [Computer use](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/computer-use.md): Computer use gives your Fleet agent access to an isolated virtual computer.
- [Essentials](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/essentials.md): LangSmith Fleet essentials are the core features that make up the foundation of your agents. They include tools, channels, memory, sub-agents, and approvals.
- [No-code agents with LangSmith Fleet](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/index.md): Sign up for a [LangSmith…
- [Manage agent settings](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/manage-agent-settings.md): This page explains how to manage the settings for your agents in LangSmith Fleet.
- [LangSmith Tool Server](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/mcp-framework.md): The LangSmith Tool Server is a standalone MCP framework for building and deploying tools with built-in authentication and authorization. Use the Tool Server when you want to:
- [Quickstart](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/quickstart.md): By the end of this quickstart, you will have an Executive Assistant that labels the Gmail messages needing your attention and pauses for approval before acting, all set up without…
- [Remote MCP servers](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/remote-mcp-servers.md): You can connect LangSmith Fleet to remote MCP servers to extend your agents with additional tools and integrations.
- [Salesforce integration](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/salesforce.md): The Salesforce integration gives your agents read-only access to data in your Salesforce org. Once connected, an agent can:
- [Schedules](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/schedules.md): Schedules run your agent on a recurring time-based schedule. Use schedules when your agent needs to do work proactively, not just in response to a message or event.
- [Skills](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/skills.md): Skills are reusable capabilities that provide specialized workflows and domain knowledge to your agent.
- [Integrate Slack with an agent](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/slack-app.md): Fleet turns any agent into a Slack teammate your team can tag in a channel or message directly.
- [Integrate Teams with an agent](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/teams-app.md): With LangSmith Fleet, you can connect your agents to Microsoft Teams by registering a custom Azure Bot. Once connected, your agents can:
- [Templates](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/templates.md): LangSmith Fleet includes [starter templates](https://www.langchain.com/templates) to help you create agents quickly.
- [Tool integrations](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/tools.md): You can access a variety of tools in LangSmith Fleet.
- [Fleet webhooks](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/webhooks.md): When triggered, a webhook sends a complete package of your agent's configuration and files to the specified endpoint.
- [Manage workspace administration](https://docs.langchain.com/langsmith/fleet/workspace-admin.md): Configure workspace secrets and manage spend limits for Fleet agents and users.
